hero.body: Find potential debris in sonar imagery. Review the evidence, understand its location, and turn a finding into an actionable report.
hero.promise: From acoustic imagery to informed decisions.
hero.caption: Illustrative sonar view

welcome.body: Bring your sonar imagery into focus. Inspect potential findings, review their context, and keep the evidence together.
welcome.hint: Explore the demo with real sonar imagery.

story.problem_body: On the seafloor, debris can look like rock. Shadows can look like objects. Reading sonar takes patience, context and careful judgement.
story.solution_body: BluEcho brings detection, visual inspection and human review into one workspace—so every finding can become a report with evidence behind it.
story.diff_body: Our focus is the connection between a detection and a defensible decision. The source, model and review history travel with every finding.
story.diff_private_title_hosted: A choice of where to work
story.diff_private_body_hosted: Use this hosted workspace or run BluEcho locally when your imagery needs to stay on your device.
story.diff_private_body_browser: Your images are analyzed in your browser. The local application supports offline workflows after setup.
story.diff_private_body_local: Process imagery locally, with offline workflows available after dependencies and models are prepared.
story.diff_control_body: Model suggestions start the inspection. Human review shapes the report, and original predictions remain traceable.
story.diff_evidence_body: Clear model limitations, uncalibrated scores and source-backed locations. Experimental findings stay labelled.

features.specialists_body: Choose a detector suited to side-scan or forward-looking imagery. Inspect predictions in the original image.
features.acoustic_body: Examine quality flags, shadows and the surrounding seabed alongside each potential object.
features.review_body: Retain, reject or correct a finding. Your notes and decisions stay linked to the original prediction.
features.maps_body: Place findings on a map when matching coordinates are available. Missing locations stay clearly marked.
features.batch_body: Queue several images and review each result separately, without mixing their sources or evidence.
features.reports_body: Take annotated imagery, review history and findings with you in PDF, JSON, CSV or GeoJSON.

onboarding.step1_desc: Import side-scan sonar (SSS) or forward-looking sonar (FLS) records. Raw XTF recordings and standard image formats (PNG, JPG, BMP, PBM) are all supported.
onboarding.step1_highlight: Your imagery stays private — processed locally on your device.
onboarding.step1_detail: Supports XTF, PNG, JPG, BMP, PBM · TIFF / GeoTIFF
onboarding.step2_desc: Confirm the sonar type and pair your imagery with a specialized detector. Each model is calibrated to a specific acoustic profile — side-scan pipelines, FLS debris, or ghost-pot detection.
onboarding.step2_highlight: Detectors are tuned to specific sonar acoustics for maximum precision.
onboarding.step2_detail: SSS · SSS_LF · FLS_ARIS · FLS_UATD sensor routes
onboarding.step3_desc: Examine candidate detections directly on the original acoustic pixels. Retain valid findings, flag false alerts, adjust bounding boxes, and attach field notes — all decisions are traceable.
onboarding.step3_highlight: Human judgement stays in control; original model predictions remain immutable.
onboarding.step3_detail: Retain · False alert · Uncertain · Correct label or box
onboarding.step4_desc: Download field-ready PDF summary briefs, mapped GeoJSON vectors, CSV anomaly logs, portable HTML evidence bundles, or complete ZIP packages for stakeholders and auditors.
onboarding.step4_highlight: Every export preserves data provenance and your full review history.
onboarding.step4_detail: PDF · GeoJSON · CSV · HTML · ZIP · JSON formats
